Name: Unofficial 1.6 Update for Kit's Sebastian
Author: faelikeloathing
Description:
Like it says on the tin, this is an update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19194]asarigolo's[/url] portrait mod. Most of the 'update' was just making it work with his winter sprites. Thanks to my sister [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66845706]Tekimimotaku[/url] for doing the minimal actual sprite editing required- I may be an artist, but I suck at pixel art. In the event asarigolo updates theirs, I'll probably take this down, but until then.

Everything is toggleable, as with the original.

Should be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11910]Sebastian's Less Wide Beach Portrait[/url], because Teki insisted on it, and what was I gonna do, say no?
